items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: And George Dixon, Walter Fuller on drums.

ctx.x: So we were talking about Chicago and the Grand Terrace, and that was when Earl Hines was in the Grand Terrace with that great band he had with Billie Franklin and all those guys, Cecil Erwin and Quinn Wilson. when I had
No, he Quinn was there. And George Dixon, Walter Fuller on drums. (Ed. note- Fuller on trumpet)
Remember that little huchback, the trumpet player, Mitch?
